title: Enumerating Prime Patterns in Juggling Variations
summary: Juggling patterns can be mathematically modeled as closed walks within directed state graphs. In this paper, we present a unified framework of unbounded juggling patterns and its variations (including multiplex, colored, and passing) primarily through the formalism of the juggling state. By extending this state-based approach and utilizing combinatorial tools such as set partitions and filled Ferrers diagrams, we find and prove a new lower bound on the number of $b$-ball prime patterns with period $n$.
